author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: two head-and-shoulder busts side by side in the shared user.svg construction, each circular head exactly 8 above its shoulder crest (4 visible; nearest body point is the crest under the head), with broad shallow shoulder arcs 16 wide as in the reference. A first HRECT_L candidate with tall narrow shoulders was rejected as nearly identical to the rejected drawing.
omissions: The woman's fringe (a hairline across the right head) is dropped: on an r6 head any hairline leaves a cap or face region under 8 units, and a larger head leaves no room for the shoulders with the required 8-unit gap. Both busts are therefore the same.
drawing_plan: HRECT_M, busts at x=12 and x=36: heads r6 at y=16; shoulder cubics from (cx-8,38) to crest (cx,30) to (cx+8,38).
lucide_reference: Lucide 'users': equal circular heads over rounded shoulder arcs; human proportions from icon_set/references/human_ref/user.svg.
